question: Should OpenClaw adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical export and authoring format for the experimental core Claws lifecycle once the parent stack is ready?
rationale: This is a new core-facing package format and export default, not a repair to an established contract; the open RFC and protected maintainer label do not establish final product acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor the format after stack landing
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical format once the parent lifecycle PRs land and current-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

options.title: Retain JSON as canonical
options.body: Keep grouped JSON as the export and authoring contract, declining this additional YAML/Markdown format surface.

options.title: Pause the Claws format decision
options.body: Defer the format adapter until the experimental Claws lifecycle has a maintainer-approved product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the format after stack landing
recommendation.body: Accept `CLAW.md` as the experimental canonical format once the parent lifecycle PRs land and current-head lifecycle proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the identified feature-stack owner with the clearest context for narrowing the proposal; a repository maintainer still must make the product decision.
